textual.context: The speaker describes their own reported lending results and platform terms; the source presents this favorably rather than as a warning or third-party report.
textual.potential_relevance: A reported interest return is linked to placing funds into tiered BitConnect loans, with stated holding and release conditions that may affect a viewer considering the described investment activity.
textual.limitations: The records do not independently verify the platform, the displayed spreadsheet, the stated interest rates, the capital-release terms, or whether viewers received any return.
